testId: testim-migrated/tests/webstore/shopping-cart/verify-navigation-to-home-after-continue-shopping.spec.ts > Webstore - Shopping Cart > verify navigation to home page after continue shopping

scenario.summary: A guest adds one simple product, opens the cart and checks that Continue Shopping returns to the home page; the user then signs in (the guest cart merges), checks Continue Shopping again, removes all items and logs out.
steps: Guest: add sku with quantity 1 and open the cart
Check the Continue Shopping button label, click it, check the URL path is "/" on the same origin
Sign in as the registered user and open the cart
Check the Continue Shopping button label, click it, check the URL path is "/" on the same origin
Open the cart, remove all items if any, check the empty cart message
stateChanges: Guest cart: product added, merged into the registered user's cart at sign-in
Registered user's cart: all items removed at cleanup
assertions: Continue Shopping button is visible and its text equals continueShoppingLabel (guest and signed-in)
After clicking Continue Shopping the URL path is "/" and the origin is unchanged (guest and signed-in)
Empty cart message is visible and equals emptyShoppingCartMessage after cleanup
Sign-in link is visible after logout
evidence: Title: 'verify navigation to home page after continue shopping'
Step labels: '1) (Guest) add a product and open the cart' ... '6) Log out'
Profile: sku z-240008 is an active SimpleProduct (RegUi_SimpleProd), PRODUCTION, inventory 999 (not store-filtered)
_recordedExpectedUrl is only logged, not asserted (the spec asserts the current host origin instead), so it is config
Store: MaxwellsHardware (Playwright webstore pilot store; the spec names none)
